testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app with modular, clean components in /src/components/.
Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx) for all components.
Ensure dark mode is default with class 'dark' added on <html> or container element, persisted in localStorage.
Use lucide-react icons extensively for tech stacks, badges, and controls.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions like copying email and submitting contact form.
Ensure 100% responsiveness with mobile navigation and floating CTA buttons.
Add data-testid to every button, input, link, tab, modal, and key card.
